newsitem.title: USA: Donnelley Enterprise sets IPO value at $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Donnelley Enterprise sets IPO value at $65 mln.

text.p: Donnelley Enterprise Solutions Inc has set terms of its initial public offering at 2.6 million shares to be offered in a range of $24 to $26 each, making the deal worth about $65 million, according to a regulatory filing.

The company is a unit of R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co. Previously, Donnelley had filed for an offering of 5.2 million shares with no price range. Of the 5.2 millin shares, 3.18 million would have been offered by the company and 2.02 million would have been offered by selling shareholders.
Under the new filing, Donnelley Enterprises will offer 1,855,000 shares and parent company R.R. Donnelley will offer 745,000.
